thread:
aisha-peopleops: Last call for SOC2/ISO evidence uploads — final sprint this week. We're closing collection this Friday 18:00 PT. Please upload any outstanding artifacts to the Evidence Vault: https://redwood.internal/evidence-vault (SSO only).

A few quick notes: short checklist below, and a required filename convention so auditors can map files automatically. Reply here if you're blocked. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

aisha-peopleops: Required artifacts (most common missing items): access reviews, change-control logs, vendor contracts (redact PII), network diagrams (PDF/PNG), DR runbook + test report, and evidence of role-based access config. If your team owns customer data flows, please include the dataflow diagram with annotations.

aisha-peopleops: Filename convention (please copy):
```
soc2_v2025_<owner>-<artifact>-YYYYMMDD.pdf
# example: soc2_v2025_devon-change-control-20250319.pdf
```

aisha-peopleops: Upload tips: use the "Team Upload" option and tag the artifact owner in the metadata field. If file >50MB, use the secure transfer link provided on the upload page.

aisha-peopleops: Action items: 1) Upload artifacts, 2) Add yourself as owner in the "evidence owner" form (link on the upload page), 3) React to this thread with :white_check_mark: when done.

devon-eng: Quick Q — change-control logs, do we need signed approvals or a consolidated ticket export is fine?

aisha-peopleops: Consolidated ticket export is fine as long as approvers are named and timestamps included. If approvals are in Google Docs, screenshot the approval + link.

nate-security: For infra diagrams, do we need CIDR-level details or high-level network zones? We redacted CIDRs for public docs.

aisha-peopleops: High-level network zones are sufficient for the auditors; include CIDR only if it lives in an internal doc with restricted access. Note that redaction is required for any customer IPs.

emma-privacy: Also flagging privacy training proofs — do we accept LMS completion screenshots or the CSV export?

aisha-peopleops: CSV export preferred (it maps to user IDs). If you only have screenshots, upload them and we'll reconcile. Please label training artifacts with `privacy-training` in the filename.

ComplianceBot: Reminder scheduled: 24h before deadline, we'll post a summary of teams still missing artifacts. If you see a message from me, please ping your folks.

devon-eng: Uploaded change-control export and added myself as owner. Reacted.

aisha-peopleops: Thanks Devon — marking in tracker. If any team needs help scanning/redacting, ping me or drop files in the secure channel and we'll assist.

aisha-peopleops: Final note — auditors will start sampling next Monday morning. If your artifacts are not uploaded by the deadline we may need to request extensions. Please prioritize this sprint. :pray:
